source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6 ("Four contests in Fermanagh local government elections")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Citation confirmed 7 Nov 2026 from the page image: the Fermanagh Herald's list of candidates returned unopposed prints 'Roslea, Thomas Beagan (Fras. J. Lynch)'.

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Lisnaskea rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Three Unionist-held divisions were contested by Anti-Partitionists, and the Unionists held all three. Anti-Partitionist; in place of Francis J. Lynch Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Roslea' to Rosslea (19 Nov 2026, w19-merges, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official DED name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Clones No. 2 Rural District) and the NI DED maps of 1921-39 name the DED Rosslea, as the rounds of 1924, 1930, 1933 and 1964 are filed. This round was filed as 'Roslea', the spelling of its source, kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (roslea) answers with a redirect to this one.
